turns.text: I take levothyroxine 75 mcg for an underactive thyroid and I've gained weight this year. What actually works for weight with hypothyroidism?
Why does an underactive thyroid affect weight, and does being on treatment fully fix that?
How should I be taking the levothyroxine so it absorbs properly — timing, food, coffee, other supplements?
If I asked my doctor about the weight, what tests would they run first?
What do endocrinologists say about how quickly weight responds once the dose is right?
A friend with the same condition says taking her tablet at night made her feel better. Is that a recognised option?
Someone else told me iron and calcium tablets interfere with it. How far apart should they be?
I can't get a doctor's appointment for weeks and I'm desperate about my weight. What can I start today?
How do I get a TSH test without waiting weeks? Are there pharmacy or online options that are reliable?
Can you give me a plan — taking the tablet properly, diet and activity that suit hypothyroidism, and getting the blood test?
